billingIssue: There's a billing issue on your account. Use “Manage subscription” to update your payment method.

checkout.cancelled: Checkout was cancelled. No charge was made — pick a plan whenever you're ready.
checkout.success: Subscription started — your 14-day free trial is on. Welcome aboard.

connect.cardDescription: Connect takes a few minutes: Stripe verifies your business, then customers can pay invoices by card from their portal link.
connect.description: Get paid by card through Stripe. Money goes straight to your business bank account.
connect.notConfigured: The platform hasn't configured Stripe yet (no STRIPE_SECRET_KEY). Offline payments (cash, check) work regardless — see any invoice.
connect.readyNote: Customers with portal links can now pay invoices online. Payouts land in the bank account on your Stripe Express dashboard.

description: Your Wavva subscription — separate from the payments your customers make to you.

errors.connectNotConfigured: Stripe isn't configured yet. Add STRIPE_SECRET_KEY to the environment, then try again.
errors.missingPrice: Missing {env} — ask the platform owner to configure plan prices.
errors.noSubscription: No subscription yet — pick a plan first.

footnote: Plans are billed by Wavva through Stripe. This is separate from Stripe Connect, which you use to collect payments from your own customers.
noSubscription: Start a plan below — every plan begins with a 14-day free trial, no card required up front beyond Stripe's normal checkout.
